programme.desc: Baby woolly monkey Bueno Jnr is going strong at four weeks old, while there is peace and harmony at last for marmoset Max. Baby orangutan Silvestre makes his mark. (S7, ep 20)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Catch Me If You Can: Amanda tries to help a snared hyena. The team's plan to release a troop of monkeys is thwarted by last-minute surgery and some very crafty escape artists. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Haven Of Giants: It's the end of the dry season at the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy, and rangers now face the challenge of keeping elephants away from the local villages. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: High Life In The Dead Mountains
programme.desc: In Austria's Totes Gebirge, a stark karst plateau of caves and dry peaks hides a rich ecosystem where wildlife thrives against the odds.

programme.title: Shark: British Isles Special...
programme.desc: ...with Steve Backshall: Steve explores a world of sharks right on your doorstep and films the Angelshark for the first time, discovering the threats they face.

programme.title: Ol Pejeta Diaries
programme.desc: Relentless Sun: A once-in-a-generation drought has sucked all the moisture from surrounding rivers, and the conservation team is struggling to keep up with the demand for water. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: Ol Pejeta Diaries
programme.desc: Bush Camps: Eco-tourism is the financial backbone of Ol Pejeta and its operations. See how the park manages this service and its effects on the area. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Catch Me If You Can: Amanda tries to help a snared hyena. The team's plan to release a troop of monkeys is thwarted by last-minute surgery and some very crafty escape artists. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Haven Of Giants: It's the end of the dry season at the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy, and rangers now face the challenge of keeping elephants away from the local villages. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Africa's Wild Horizons
programme.desc: The Kalahari: The immense desert of the Kalahari dominates southwestern Africa. Rain disappears as it quickly as falls, providing its plucky inhabitants with brutal conditions. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Big Cats An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests a cheetah's speed and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat. (2 of 2)

programme.title: The Wild Wild East
programme.desc: Deer: In Hampton, New Brunswick, the deer population is running wild. Sightings have reached an all-time high and residents fear the overpopulation may be at its tipping point. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: The Wild Wild East
programme.desc: Whales: In the surrounding waters of Brier Island live an incredible number of humpback whales and dolphins. It's an incredible sight. (S1, ep 14)

programme.title: Living Beach
programme.desc: Australia: Just beyond Australia's Queensland State is Fraser Island - a complex ecosystem that is built entirely upon sand. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Living Beach
programme.desc: California: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but they risk falling out of balance due to mankind's effects on nature. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Witness how summer turns Alaska into a true wildlife paradise, from the bears fishing in its salmon-filled waterways to the millions of migratory birds that flock there.

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Smell: Detecting chemical scents was one of the first skills that animals developed, and is vital for finding everything from possible mates to potential predators. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Touch: Some animals have developed an extraordinary sense of touch, and are able to pick up the tiniest vibrations that humans could only dream of. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Sight: One of the most amazing senses in the world, sight helps animals spot their prey - and avoid their predators. Learn how creatures throughout nature harness this gift. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Hearing: Whether through the air or through water, some animals have evolved to perceive changes in their environment through the sense of hearing. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: Super Senses: Experience abilities beyond human limits, from crocs sensing movement to pigeons navigating and dolphins hunting with a seventh sense. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Slovenia: Where Nature Comes...
programme.desc: Discover Slovenia's remarkable wildlife and landscapes, where people and nature thrive together in one of Europe's greenest countries.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Dragons And Damsels
programme.desc: They are beautiful, their behaviour is as complex as mammals and they have existed since the dinosaurs. David Attenborough uncovers the life of dragonflies and damselflies.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: The Journey: Go on a 750km journey down the Drava river, starting with the current's Alpine origins to its delta in the Pannonian Basin. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: The Wetlands: Dive into the great floodplains that lie along the Drava River - areas that are at risk of intense seasonal flooding - before exploring the wetlands of Kopacki Rit. (2 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: Life in the Wet Zone: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday we follow him through the the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew.. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: In celebration of Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, we explore the secret life of plants at Kew, following along as he examines everything. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: David Attenborough concludes his absorbing journey around London's Kew Gardens, as he discovers how some plants have evolved to shed their dependency on water. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack Vs. Pride
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Tragedy Strikes Kakumbi: Join Julz on a lion-collaring mission, go fishing with scout Simon and witness a heartbreaking vigil for a badly injured Kakumbi pup. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack Vs. Pride
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Manzi the Superpack: Rejoin the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups, before entering a standoff between a leopard and an angry elephant herd. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Ancient Enemies: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Pride Rules
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe's banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it. (5 of 5)

programme.title: Matsalu Moose: Wild Giants Of The Baltics
programme.desc: Matsalu National Park is home to an exceptionally large moose colony. Join two yearlings as they roam the open marshes and thrive in this extraordinary moose kingdom.
